name: API Spec Viewer
description: An interactive API reference in Orca's editor tabs for OpenAPI 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2, Swagger 2.0, AsyncAPI 2 and 3, Arazzo and Overlay files in YAML or JSON: operations by tag, nested schemas, examples, offline code samples, a problems panel with line numbers, and search. Opens openapi.yaml, *.openapi.json and similar names by itself; any other YAML or JSON file from the view toggle. Read-only and offline. Independent; not affiliated with the OpenAPI Initiative, SmartBear or the AsyncAPI Initiative.
